senses.gloss: unimportant, of minor value; easy to achieve.—קל וחומר, v. חוֹמֶר I.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:5">Ḥull. XII, 5</cite> <he>מצוה ק׳ שהיא כאיסר</he> a slight religious act which is performed at a sacrifice of one Isar.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:14">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>השוה הכתוב מצוה ק׳ שבקַלּוֹת וכ׳</he> the Bible put the lightest of the light acts (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 22:7">Deut. XXII, 7</cite>) on the same level with the most serious (<cite ref="Exodus 20:12">Ex. XX, 12</cite>). Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 4 <he>מאכילין אותו הקל הקל</he> you must give him to eat (of forbidden things on hand) that which is of comparatively minor import; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S01315"><he>קַלִּים</he></cite>, <he>קַלִּין</he>; <cite ref="S01300"><he>קַלּוֹת</he></cite>.—<he>קלים וחמורים</he>, v. <cite ref="H00390"><he>חוֹמֶר</he> I</cite>.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:1">Dem. I, 1</cite> <he>הק׳ שבדמאי</he> those fruits with which, in cases of doubt as to tithes (v. <cite ref="D00871"><he>דְּמַאי</he></cite>), the law deals most leniently.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:8">Yoma VIII, 8</cite> <he>על עבירות ק׳</he> for minor transgressions (to which the lowest penalty is attached); <cite ref="Yoma 85b:14">ib. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>אלו הן ק׳ וכ׳</he> these are the minor transgressions: omission of a positive command &c. (v. <cite ref="P01466"><he>עָשָׂה</he></cite>); Tosef. ib. V (IV), 5.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25b:2">R. Hash. 25ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>שלשה קַלֵּי עולם</he> the three worthless (chiefs) in Israel’s history, opp. <he>חמורי עולם</he>.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אפי׳ קל שבק׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>קלין</he>) even the most worthless of worthless men, if once appointed a leader, should be respected like the strongest &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Arakhin 24a:39">Arakh. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא ישהא מרגלית לק׳</he> one must not delay the valuation of a jewel dedicated for its value by poor men (for the sake of taking it to a large town where a higher price can be obtained, but it must go by its local value); <cite ref="Arakhin 18a:39">ib. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>מרגלית לק׳</he> as to local valuation.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:12">Ab. III, 12</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00343"><he>נוֹחַ</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:20">Ib. V, 20</cite> <he>הוי … קל כנשר וכ׳</he> be … swift as an eagle, and run like a deer to do the will of thy Father in heaven.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Sabb. VIII, 5</cite> <he>ביצה ק׳ שבבצים</he> the lightest of eggs; expl.
<cite ref="Shabbat 80b:6">ib. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ לבשל</he> quick to boil; Y. ib. VIII, 11ᵇ top.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:4">Gen. R. s. 16</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00168"><he>חַד</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 112a:14">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 3:19">Jer. III, 19</cite> <he>נחלת צבי</he>) <he>מה צבי זה קל … ק׳ לבשל וכ׳</he> as the deer is the swiftest of beasts, so the land of Israel is the swiftest of all lands to ripen its fruits.
Ex. R. s. 19, a. fr. לשעה קלה after a short time; a. fr.—Pl. as ab. Gen. R. l. c.; a. e.
